html:
SMTO-EVT-0004 — SMTO didn't recognize that notification status

GUID: 71f0dc4c-47bc-4ee9-ab10-37c12ecbcdc1
Slug: notification-status-invalid
Domain: EVT · Subsystem: evt

What happened

  • A request asked to show or change notifications using a status SMTO doesn't support. Nothing was changed. This usually comes from an outdated page or a script, not from something you typed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the Notifications page. An old copy of the page may send a status SMTO no longer accepts.
  2. Use Mark read or Dismiss on the notification you want to change. Those are the only two changes SMTO allows on a notification.
  3. If a script or other tool made this request, ask its owner to filter only by unread, read or dismissed, and to set only read or dismissed. Any other status word is refused, so the tool must use one of these.

What success looks like

  • The notification moves to Read or Dismissed, and the list loads without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the name of the page or tool you were using, to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The notification API rejected the status (400): list filters must be unread, read or dismissed, and updates may only set read or dismissed.

What this means

  • Notification listing receives a filter outside unread/read/dismissed, or notification editing requests a state outside read/dismissed. Event, monitor and notification identities have separate owners. Rejected control or missing notification does not cancel an existing task; only authoritative run state establishes its outcome.

Why this can happen

  • Notification listing receives a filter outside unread/read/dismissed, or notification editing requests a state outside read/dismissed.

How to diagnose it

  • Distinguish a list filter from an edit; unread is a valid filter but not an advertised edit action here.

How to fix it

  • Fix the caller: GET /api/agent/notifications accepts a status filter of unread, read or dismissed; the notification PATCH route (update_agent_notification) accepts status read or dismissed only. Reload stale browser clients so they use the current values.
  • Use unread/read/dismissed for listing, or the supported Read or Dismiss edit action.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The exact route receives one of its supported status values.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Event, monitor and notification identities have separate owners. Rejected control or missing notification does not cancel an existing task; only authoritative run state establishes its outcome.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
